d:
Ramlila Maidan Rally : vot ki laraee ko lekar dilli men siyasi halchal tej hai. chunav aayog aur mukhy chunav aayukt gyanesh kumar ke khilaph vipaksh ne morcha khol rakha hai. 31 aktubar ko INDIA gathbandhan ke netaon ne mok sansad ke jarie apni mangen uthaeen. vahin, 1 navanbar ko dilli ke ramlila maidan men 'vot bachao-desh bachao' raili ke jarie vipaksh shakti pradarshan karega.
Vipaksh ki pramukh mangon men mukhy chunav aayukt ke istiphe, SIR par rok aur chunav men bailet pepar ki vapsi shamil hai. is pure ghatnakram ko lekar jharkhand ki siyasat men bhi halchal hai.
